name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Central government income support scheme providing direct cash transfers to eligible farmer families to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and household expenses.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

additional_conditions: Must be a landholding farmer family with cultivable land in their name
Excludes serving/retired government employees above a certain pay grade
Excludes income-tax payers in the last assessment year

benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 directly to bank accounts.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: National health insurance scheme providing free secondary and tertiary care hospitalization coverage to economically vulnerable families.
department: National Health Authority, Government of India

additional_conditions: Household must be identified as eligible under SECC 2011 deprivation/occupational criteria
Eligibility is determined by the SECC database, not a simple income threshold — verify via the official beneficiary lookup tool

benefits: Health cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.

name: Vay Vandana Pension Yojana (Gujarat)
description: Gujarat state old-age pension scheme providing monthly financial assistance to elderly citizens from economically weaker sections.
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat
benefits: Monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 credited directly to bank account.
